newsitem.title: USA: Westinghouse holders approve shrs for merger.
newsitem.headline: Westinghouse holders approve shrs for merger.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp said on Tuesday its shareholders approved an amendment to increase the number of authorized common shares and the issuance of shares related to its planned merger with Infinity Broadcasting Corp.
The company also said Infinity shareholders had approved the merger plan, proposed on June 20, paving the way for the merger to proceed pending U.S. Federal Communications Commission approval.
The U.S. Department of Justice approved the merger on November 12, the company said.
Finalization of the transaction remained subject to FCC approval of the transfer of control of Infinity to Westinghouse and the satisfaction of customary closing conditions, it said.
The companies have entered into agreements to divest stations in Chicago and Dallas in order to fully comply with local station ownership limits.
The combined radio group would operate 79 radio stations in 17 markets, including 64 stations in the top 10 markets, Westinghouse said.
